verdict: Leads up, cost per lead down — but Google spend needs its tracking fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 134 leads at $16.48 per lead, entirely through Meta — and the most recent 7 days show the right direction: leads up 12.5% and cost per lead down week-over-week. Google Ads ran $532 in spend over the same window with zero tracked conversions; the confirmed cause is a tracking failure, not a bidding problem, and that is being repaired now. Conversion tracking for Google will be live by end of September, at which point that spend will begin optimizing properly. Expect the lead volume trend to hold steady next week, with cleaner data across both paid channels as fixes come online.
